label: a drawing of a can.
why: A line drawing of a wide can with a rimmed lid, seen from slightly above, while a hand with a pen draws a peeling label shape on its upper left. From 2.0 to 6.0 s the hand sits at the lower right and the can is mostly unblocked; the frame-difference spikes start at 6.25 s when the hand moves fast and blurs, so the interval ends before them. The can itself does not move.
